mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, device_name, floor_name, start_at, end_at FROM device_work_period WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND end_at IS NULL ORDER BY start_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_work_period (device_id, device_name, floor_name, start_at, end_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{floorName}, #{startAt}, #{endAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, device_id, device_name, floor_name, start_at, end_at FROM device_work_period WHERE start_at < #{endAt} AND (end_at IS NULL OR end_at > #{startAt})
AND device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND floor_name = #{floorName}
ORDER BY start_at ASC
